newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific Resources names CEO and COO.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific Resources names CEO and COO.

text.p: Union Pacific Resources Group Inc said on Monday that its board named Jack Messman as chairman and chief executive officer and selected George Lindahl III as president and chief operating officer.

Messman was president, chief executive officer and a director of Union Pacific Resources, the company said, and is a director of several companies, including Novell Inc, Cambridge Technology Partners Inc and Union Pacific Corp.
Lindahl has been with the company since 1987 as executive vice president in charge of exploration and production.
Company spokesman Mike Liebschwager said Messman becomes chairman succeeding Drew Lewis, who will remain on the board. The position of chief operating officer was newly created, he said.
